issues.title: All Crawled Pages Returned Valid Status
issues.description: No 4xx, 5xx, or network errors were detected among crawled pages.
issues.recommendation: Continue monitoring server logs and internal links regularly.

issues.title: All Pages Use Secure HTTPS
issues.description: All crawled pages are securely delivered over HTTPS protocol.
issues.recommendation: Ensure SSL/TLS certificates are set to auto-renew.

issues.title: Missing Rel="Canonical" Tag
issues.description: 1 page(s) do not specify a canonical URL tag in their <head>.
issues.recommendation: Add a self-referential or target canonical link tag (<link rel="canonical" href="...">) to prevent duplicate content issues.

issues.title: Title Tag Too Short (< 30 characters)
issues.description: 1 page(s) have titles under 30 characters, missing keyword opportunities.
issues.recommendation: Expand title tags to between 30 and 60 characters with descriptive primary keywords and brand name.

issues.title: Missing Meta Description
issues.description: 1 page(s) do not define a meta description tag.
issues.recommendation: Add compelling meta descriptions (120-155 characters) summarizing the page and enticing search clicks.

issues.title: Missing Open Graph Metadata
issues.description: 1 page(s) lack complete Open Graph tags (og:title or og:image).
issues.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image tags for rich preview rendering on social platforms.

issues.title: No Structured Data (Schema.org / JSON-LD) Detected
issues.description: 1 page(s) do not include JSON-LD or Microdata schema markup.
issues.recommendation: Implement Schema.org JSON-LD markup (such as WebSite, Organization, Article, or Product) to qualify for rich snippets in Google SERPs.

issues.title: Thin Content (< 200 words)
issues.description: 1 page(s) have fewer than 200 words of visible text.
issues.recommendation: Enrich page copy with detailed, high-value content relevant to user search intent.

issues.title: Zero Broken Internal Links Found
issues.description: All internal links tested across crawled pages resolved successfully.
issues.recommendation: Periodically re-crawl to catch any newly created broken URLs.

issues.title: robots.txt File Missing (404)
issues.description: The website does not provide a robots.txt file at /robots.txt.
issues.recommendation: Create a robots.txt file to guide search engine crawlers and declare sitemap locations.

issues.title: XML Sitemap Not Found
issues.description: No valid XML sitemap was discovered in robots.txt or standard paths (/sitemap.xml).
issues.recommendation: Generate and submit an XML sitemap to Google Search Console to aid discovery of deep URLs.

issues: robots.txt was not found (404). Search engines will assume everything is crawlable, but having one is recommended.
